verdict.rationale: Babylon.js ships its own Playground, an interactive code editor at playground.babylonjs.com, which implies a quick edit-and-run preview loop for scripts. The evidence is only a one-line listing and never describes preview speed or reload behavior. missing for 10: documented hot reload for local project workflows, explicit evidence of near-instant preview after script changes, hands-on or independent corroboration of edit-run loop speed.

support.subject: As a game developer, the edit-run loop is fast — hot reload or near-instant preview after a script change
